title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 25, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.2 (Peaked November 25, 2026 at 04:33 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 381 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Quiet one right now. 💛💫

A broad coronal-hole region stands out in today’s solar images, while sunspot activity remains sparse.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
